pages.title: Choose a Color
pages.text: Each color has twelve registered sword recipes. Browse a color below; return here from any tier. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) for ingot advancement.

pages.title: Six Curses
pages.text: On a hit, the sword lays its color curse; higher degrees hit harder and extend it. Red kindles fire; Orange lifts its foe; Yellow calls lightning; Green deals and spreads magic harm; Blue strikes foes below half health; Violet swaps places with nearby living beings. Each curse pulses in its own rhythm.
